Good game but the content is a bit short, 35mins for a run. 3 initial bosses are medium-difficulty but need more variety.

Interesting setting, good combat, a bit easy in the beginning. Build variety is good, but the game is missing content and unless the amount of content triples at least, that is the biggest downfall. So if you enjoy rerunning the same game with different builds, this is for you. Otherwise wait for a sale.
Aksun: A dynamic action roguelite inspired by Korean shamanism. Battle demons, explore forgotten rituals, and experience evolving weapons in a world beyond death. A must-try for roguelike fans!

Roguelite-экшен, вдохновлённый корейским шаманизмом. Вас затягивает внутрь проклятого артефакта, известного как Печать. Каждое прохождение начинается с вашего пробуждения в этой тюрьме, где вас ждут..
Aksun is an atmospheric exploration game where players uncover a surreal world filled with secrets and beautiful landscapes.
Aksun delivers a Hades-like combat and a unique story with its Korean shamanic folklore. Time to win the war.

Hack & Slash roguelite with deep builds & chaotic synergies! Awaken divine weapons, absorb elemental artifacts, unleash devastating reactions as you descend into cursed cycle of memory, power, ritual!
An intriguing roguelike with solid combat but weak motivation and unclear goals. The world needs more depth, and repetitive voice lines hurt immersion. Still, it’s a well-executed game overall.
An asian style Diablo meets Hades? Seems like it. No user reviews and it has a DEMO. For more solo and offline games and hidden gems check out my list!
